articles.title: Prediction markets inch closer to the Supreme Court: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New Jersey petitioned for a writ of certiorari in Kalshi's case against it last week, finally throwing the ball to the high court.

articles.title: Ukrainian police took down a crypto scam that stole up to $1 million a month
articles.snippet: Investigators have identified 62 victims and say more than 46 Ukrainians took part in the alleged operation.

articles.title: Better and Coinbase’s bitcoin-backed mortgages can reuse borrowers’ collateral
articles.snippet: Better Mortgage can reuse the pledged bitcoin, and borrowers cannot recover their crypto until the main conventional mortgage is fully repaid or refinanced.

articles.title: Dollar-backed stablecoins can push local currencies lower, Bank of Korea study finds
articles.snippet: Buying pressure in Binance-paired currencies correlates with local currency depreciation as market makers balance positions.

articles.title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
articles.snippet: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.
